Name: AutoFenceGate
Author: LucasBennett617
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Automatically opens and closes fence gates when you get near them. Walk up to a gate and it opens; walk away and it closes.



[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]


[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url]

[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI

[/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for easy configuration

[/*]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size]


[list]
[*]Gates open automatically when you approach (default: 2.5 tiles)

[/*]
[*]Gates close automatically when you walk away

[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support for all players

[/*]
[*]Fully configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu

[/*]
[*]Press F5 in-game to reload your settings

[/*]
[*]Optimized cooldown system for better performance

[/*]
[*]No conflicts with vanilla mechanics

[/*]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]


[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.5 or higher

[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+

[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game configuration)

[/*]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[left]
Thanks to the SMAPI development team for making Stardew Valley modding so accessible, and to the modding community for the inspiration and support.[/left]
